notes: Verified high-priority Greater Tokyo/Kanto catch-up discoveries absent from the canonical RADAR. These are S-level engagements selected for living-master status, unusually strong instrumental identity, and/or a distinctive cross-genre club context.

events.factual_description: Billboard Live Tokyo presents Marcus Miller on October 5-8, 2026, with 5:30 PM and 8:30 PM sets each night. The venue frames the run around more than four decades of Miller's work, including repertoire connected to Miles Davis, David Sanborn, Roberta Flack and Luther Vandross, and lists a six-member band led by Miller on bass and bass clarinet.

sources.note: Exact official event page; dates, two set times per night, lineup, venue and purchase path verified.

provenance.note: Event facts verified against Billboard Live Tokyo's exact show page; Apple Music recommendation verified against the exact album page.

en.why_it_matters: Miller is a bass-language event, not merely a famous-name booking: his slap vocabulary, orchestration and deep connection to Miles Davis and David Sanborn put groove, tone and arrangement at the center. In a club-scale Roppongi room, the instrument itself should read with far more physical detail than in a festival or arena setting.
en.trip_verdict: S within Greater Tokyo/Kanto. Worth crossing the metro area for and strong enough to anchor a Tokyo music night; not, by itself, a transpacific-trip trigger.

es.why_it_matters: Miller es un acontecimiento de lenguaje del bajo, no sólo una contratación de nombre famoso: su vocabulario de slap, su orquestación y su conexión profunda con Miles Davis y David Sanborn ponen groove, timbre y arreglo en el centro. En una sala de escala club en Roppongi, el instrumento debería sentirse con mucho más detalle físico que en un festival o una arena.
es.trip_verdict: S dentro de Greater Tokyo/Kanto. Vale cruzar el área metropolitana y puede anclar una noche musical en Tokio; por sí solo no dispara un viaje transpacífico.

events.factual_description: Blue Note Tokyo presents Anoushka Shankar on October 9-11, 2026, for her first appearance at the club. October 9 has 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM sets; October 10-11 have 4:30 PM and 7:30 PM sets. The announced quartet is Shankar on sitar with Sarathy Korwar, Tom Farmer and Arun Ghosh, and the venue places the engagement in the context of her Chapter III project and her fusion of Indian classical tradition with contemporary cross-genre practice.

recommended_listening.title: Chapter III: We Return to Light

en.why_it_matters: This is exactly the kind of cross-genre instrumental identity Listening Notes should protect: Shankar's sitar language comes from Indian classical tradition but the announced band puts it in dialogue with Sarathy Korwar's contemporary rhythmic vocabulary, bass and clarinet. Her first Blue Note Tokyo appearance makes the club context unusually specific rather than a generic world-music tour stop.
en.trip_verdict: S within Greater Tokyo/Kanto. Build a Tokyo night around it; the instrumentation and first-appearance context make this one of the more distinctive club bookings of the fall, though not a stand-alone transpacific trip.
en.listen_before: Chapter III: We Return to Light

es.why_it_matters: Es exactamente el tipo de identidad instrumental y cruce de lenguajes que Listening Notes debe proteger: el sitar de Shankar parte de la tradición clásica india, pero la banda anunciada lo pone en diálogo con el vocabulario rítmico contemporáneo de Sarathy Korwar, bajo y clarinete. Que sea su primera aparición en Blue Note Tokyo vuelve el contexto del club especialmente específico y no una parada genérica de world music.
es.trip_verdict: S dentro de Greater Tokyo/Kanto. Vale construir una noche de Tokio alrededor de esto; la instrumentación y el contexto de primera aparición la hacen una de las contrataciones de club más distintivas del otoño, aunque no justifica sola cruzar el Pacífico.

events.factual_description: Blue Note Tokyo presents Kenny Barron Trio on November 23-25, 2026. November 23 has 4:30 PM and 7:30 PM sets; November 24-25 have 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM sets. The venue identifies Barron as a living legend and 2026 Jazz Journalists Association lifetime-achievement honoree, appearing with a new trio featuring bassist Kanoa Mendenhall and drummer Johnathan Blake.

en.why_it_matters: Barron is a genuine living-master case: touch, harmonic clarity and post-bop fluency matter more than spectacle, and Blue Note Tokyo is small enough for those details to become the event. The new-trio context also matters, especially with Johnathan Blake's elasticity behind him rather than a nostalgia-oriented legacy lineup.
en.trip_verdict: S within Greater Tokyo/Kanto. Protect one set if in Tokyo; an intimate encounter with Barron at this stage of his career is worth crossing the metro area for, though it should be folded into a broader Tokyo trip rather than trigger the Pacific crossing alone.

es.why_it_matters: Barron es un caso genuino de maestro vivo: aquí importan el toque, la claridad armónica y la fluidez post-bop más que el espectáculo, y Blue Note Tokyo es suficientemente pequeño para que esos detalles se vuelvan el acontecimiento. También pesa el contexto de trío nuevo, especialmente con la elasticidad de Johnathan Blake detrás de él y no una formación de legado nostálgico.
es.trip_verdict: S dentro de Greater Tokyo/Kanto. Hay que proteger uno de los sets si estás en Tokio; escuchar a Barron de cerca a esta altura de su carrera vale cruzar el área metropolitana, aunque conviene integrarlo a un viaje más amplio a Tokio y no cruzar el Pacífico sólo por esta fecha.
